run_mamba_generation: run the Mamba model generation script with CLI arguments to generate text from prompts
create_mamba_generator: create a PackedCausalMambaGenerator instance with a config, model, and tokenizer for text generation
generate_next_token_mamba: generate the next token using the Mamba model forward pass with ssm_update implementation
prefill_mamba_context: prefill the Mamba model context by setting up token indices and running the SSM forward pass
clear_mamba_cache: clear the SSM state cache for all Mamba modules in the model before generation
